reviews.comment: Professor Lee was super flexible, understanding, and an amazing professor. He is a generous grader, will help you in any way possible, and gives extra credit at the end of the semester. Attendance is MANDATORY as it is worth 15% of your grade! Outside of class, he is the sweetest human being too. He once bought a group of us Starbucks at Evans!

Dr. Lee is a preeminent professor that makes sure students are learning and understanding all the material. He is very flexible and gives great feedback to ensure improvement. I would recommend him for Digital Communications 2, as my AutoCAD, Sketchup, Photoshop, and Illustrator skills improved significantly by the time the course was over.

Professor Sungmin Lee has an amazing online digital communication class.

Easy to follow lectures, which help complete your work but provides room to learn on your own and be creative! Great communication with students and offers office hours. Lecture a week creates four large assignments for grading.

Have to buy some programs to use for course.
